timeline.text: Welcome to When Money Anxiety Spikes. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: Money anxiety is taking over right now.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind keeps jumping to the worst financial outcome.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I feel ashamed that this is affecting me so much.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I want to avoid looking at the numbers.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is reacting like there is immediate danger.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I feel pressure to solve everything at once.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me believes I should have handled this better.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that I feel scared.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This financial stress is taking up so much space.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can settle before I look at the next step.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: A frightening thought is not the same as a number.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can face one piece of information at a time.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: Avoiding the situation is understandable, but not required.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can come out of immediate alarm.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I do not have to solve the entire future today.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Shame will not help me see the situation clearly.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can ask for information or support if I need it.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can make this moment smaller and more specific.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am ready to look at one practical next step.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I can work with facts instead of imagined outcomes.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I trust myself to make one grounded choice.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can pause again if the anxiety rises.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can stay steady while I look at money.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: My financial situation does not define my worth.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can seek appropriate guidance when I need it.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: Small actions can create more clarity.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to begin with what is in front of me.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
